name: Evergreen International Storage & Transport Corporation
summary: Evergreen International Storage & Transport Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides inland container transport services in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers inland container terminal services, including lifting operations, and control of inbound and outbound containers; warehousing and inspection of inbound container cargo; warehousing of LCL outbound cargos; operations of the bonded warehouses; container repairing and cleaning service; and warehousing in the distribution center.
